user_instruction: This is a person wearing a swimsuit underwater. Right now she is swimming toward the camera; we want her to be swimming away from the camera.

arguments.prompt: Context: This is a person wearing a swimsuit while swimming, with her body underwater. Right now she is swimming toward the camera; we want her to be swimming away from the camera. Add yaw to the current head so she is turned away from the camera, with more of the side and back of her head visible. Keep the existing raised-chin angle, cartoon style, water, framing, and transparent background.
